sn11.14:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe || || 2.
sn11.14:1.4: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 4.
sn11.14:2.1: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave aññataro puriso imasmiṃ yeva Rājagahe manussadaliddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko || 6.
sn11.14:2.2: So Tathāgata-ppavedita-dhammavinaye saddhaṃ samādiyi sīlaṃ samādiyi sutaṃ samādiyi cāgaṃ samādiyi paññaṃ samādiyi || || 7.
sn11.14:2.3: So Tathāgata-ppavedita-dhamma-vinaye saddhaṃ samādiyitvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā sutaṃ samādiyitvā cāgaṃ samādiyitvā paññaṃ samādiyitvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokam uppajji devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahavyataṃ ||
sn11.14:2.4: so aññe deva atirocati vaṇṇena c-eva yasasā ca || || 8.
sn11.14:2.5: Tatra sudam bhikkhave devā Tāvatiṃsā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti || ||
sn11.14:2.6: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutam vata bho
sn11.14:2.7: ayaṃ hi devaputto pubbe manussabhūto samāno manussadaliddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko ||
sn11.14:2.8: so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokam uppanno devānam Tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahavyataṃ ||
sn11.14:2.9: so aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena c-eva yasasā cā ti || || 9.
sn11.14:3.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo deve Tāvatiṃse āmantesi || ||
sn11.14:3.2: Mā kho tumhe mārisā etassa devaputtassa ujjhāyittha ||
sn11.14:3.3: eso kho mārisā devaputto pubbe manussabhūto samāno Tathāgata-ppavedita-dhammavinaye saddhaṃ samādiyi sīlam samādiyi sutaṃ samādiyi cāgaṃ samādiyi paññaṃ samādīyi || ||
sn11.14:3.4: So Tathāgata-ppavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṃ samādiyitvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā sutaṃ samādiyitvā cāgaṃ samādiyitvā paññaṃ samādiyitvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatim saggaṃ lokam uppanno devānam Tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahavyataṃ ||
sn11.14:3.5: so aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena c-eva yasasā cā ti || || 10.
sn11.14:3.6: Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo deve Tāvatiṃse anunayamāno tāyaṃ velāyam imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
